pbo_caveat: The rank proxy is based on only four chronological slices and all selectable candidates lose money; stable relative rank is not economic validity.

dsr_proxy.method: expected maximum Sharpe proxy across nine deterministic candidates

negative_controls.interpretation: The shuffled score materially beat D08, so the ensemble ranking is not distinguishable from date-randomized cross-sectional exposure.

sample_data_caveats: The 468-session diagnostic uses a current ten-stock basket and is survivorship-labelled.
Alpaca Basic is IEX-only and can differ from consolidated prices and volume.
No historical event packets, transcript data, or event-factor returns were used.
The formal forward epoch starts 2026-07-20 and has zero observations.
capacity_assessment: Blocked. Portfolio notional, consolidated slot volume, quotes, spreads, and matched fills are unavailable.

execution_semantics.first_hour_feature: 09:30 open to close of the 10:00-labelled 30m bar
execution_semantics.decision_boundary: 10:30 ET after the completed signal bar

economic_review.assessment: The best gross edge is smaller than the minimum stylized round-trip cost and every fold is negative after cost.

notes: The implementation is deterministic and leak controls passed, but economic performance, placebo, event-data, source-parity, and execution evidence all fail promotion.
